_comment: USD per million tokens, Claude API first-party rates. Bundled with the app on purpose: burn must work on a machine that has nothing else installed. Every column is copied as a dollar figure from the official table rather than derived from a multiplier, because cache-read rates differ by model (0.025x on Fable 5.1 / Mythos 5.1, 0.05x on Opus 5.5 / Sonnet 5.5, 0.1x elsewhere). Source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing (checked 2026-10-08).
_columns: in = base input; out = output; cache_read = cache hits and refreshes; cache_write_5m / cache_write_1h = cache writes by TTL. 'above' = a higher price tier for turns whose prompt (input + cache read + cache write) exceeds 'tokens'.
_matching: A model id is priced only if it equals a key exactly, or is that key plus a dated snapshot suffix (-YYYYMMDD, e.g. claude-haiku-4-5-20251001). No prefix or substring matching: claude-opus-5-5 must never inherit claude-opus-5's price, and a newer id with no entry must show as unpriced.
_unknown_model_policy: A model with no entry is counted in tokens and excluded from cost, and the UI says so. Guessing a price would silently corrupt the only number this app exists to report.
